indication_area: Sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia
revenue_scope: CASGEVY net product revenue as printed by Vertex: a product-named line inside consolidated product revenues, in 'Other product revenues' until the first quarter 2026 release and as its own CASGEVY table row from then
geography: Worldwide (consolidated line; the release prints no regional split of CASGEVY revenue)
formulation: autologous CD34+ cell suspension for infusion
moa: Autologous CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell therapy edited ex vivo with non-viral CRISPR/Cas9 at the erythroid-specific BCL11A enhancer, increasing fetal hemoglobin

approval_evidence.quote: Our STN: BL 125787/0 BLA APPROVAL December 08, 2023 ... Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc ... exagamglogene autotemcel (exa-cel) ... indicated for treatment of sickle cell disease (SCD) in patients 12 years of age or older with recurrent vaso-occlusive crises (VOCs). (CBER biologics are not on accessdata.fda.gov; this is the approval letter linked from https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/casgevy)

series_start_reason: FDA approval was December 8, 2023, but Vertex printed no CASGEVY revenue before the third quarter of 2024: its third-quarter 2024 release says product revenue 'included revenue from the first patient infused with CASGEVY', and its first- and second-quarter 2025 releases state there were no revenues for CASGEVY and JOURNAVX in the first quarter and in the three and six months ended June 30, 2024.
notes: Series is worldwide CASGEVY revenue in USD millions. 2024Q3 (2.0) is read from the revenue note of the quarter's own 10-Q (the earnings release prints no amount); 2024Q4 (8.0) is printed in the fourth-quarter 2024 release text. 2025Q1-2025Q4 are printed in release/10-Q sentences saying 'Other product revenues' included the CASGEVY amount (no CASGEVY table row existed), so their row_label is 'Other product revenues'. 2026Q1 and 2026Q2 are rows of the release's revenue table. Full-year checks: 2024 quarters 2.0 + 8.0 = 10.0 as printed ($10.0 million); 2025 quarters 14.2 + 30.4 + 16.9 + 54.3 = 115.8, equal to the printed $115.8 million. The 10-K lists CASGEVY under patents (2034/2035), not as a revenue table. The series runs to 2026Q2, Vertex's second-quarter 2026 release filed 2026-08-03, the latest quarter published.
search_log: EDGAR submissions for Vertex (CIK 875320) listed; opened the exhibit 99.1 of every earnings 8-K from Q4 2023 (filed 2024-02-05) to Q2 2026 (filed 2026-08-03) and scanned table rows and sentences for CASGEVY

Q4 2023, Q1 2024 and Q2 2024 releases: CASGEVY appears only in guidance/launch prose, no revenue amount; Q3 2024 release: 'Vertex's product revenue included revenue from the first patient infused with CASGEVY' with no amount

Q3 2024 10-Q (vrtx-20240930.htm) revenue note: 'Other product revenues included CASGEVY product revenues of $2.0 million' for the three and nine months (verifier-side correction; the Q3 2025 10-Q repeats it as the prior-year comparative)

Q1 2025 release: 'In the first quarter of 2024, there were no revenues for these products'; Q2 2025 release: 'In the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, there were no revenues for these products' - so no CASGEVY revenue before 2024Q3

Q4 2024 release: 'The three and twelve month periods ending December 31, 2024, included CASGEVY revenue of $8.0 million and $10.0 million'; FY2024 10-K (vrtx-20241231.htm) and FY2025 10-K (vrtx-20251231.htm) scanned: no CASGEVY revenue table, 10-K FY2025 text '$115.8 million of CASGEVY product revenues'
Bigdata.com was not used; documents were located directly through EDGAR submissions and Archives indexes
